# Walk-to-Paint: Comprehensive Posthoc Results

> **⚠️ SUPERSEDED for absolute SOTA numbers (2026-06-29).** AUCs and the `E14_HARDNODE_L10`
> tag below are the **old uniform-sampler** results (~85–88% walk coverage on sparse graphs).
> Current full-coverage SOTA is **E15 k_cover k=5** — see
> `outputs/walk_coverage_analysis/E15_SWEEP_RESULTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`'s SOTA table.
> Aggregator-ranking conclusions still hold; only the absolute numbers/budgets are stale.

> **Encoding**: class 0 = distrust/negative, class 1 = trust/positive, q_j = P(class 1).  
> **Metric**: Edge-level test AUC (for aggregation models) / direct test AUC (for baselines).  
> **Seed**: 42 for all experiments.  
> `—` = not yet computed.

## 1. Experiment Setup

| Dataset | Transformer config | Best epoch | Val AUC |
|---|---|---|---|
| bitcoin-alpha | seed42, nw=5M, mw=80, bs=1024, ep=75 | 24 | 0.9342 |
| bitcoin-otc   | seed42, nw=500k, mw=80, bs=1024, ep=50 | 60 | 0.9247 |
| epinions      | seed42, nw=500k, mw=80, bs=1024, ep=50 | 42 | 0.9344 |
| wiki-elec     | seed42, nw=500k, mw=80, bs=1024, ep=50 | 36 | 0.8544 |
| wiki-rfa      | seed42, nw=500k, mw=80, bs=1024, ep=50 | 25 | 0.8630 |
| slashdot      | seed42, nw=5M, mw=80, bs=1024, ep=50  | 20 | 0.9279 |

**Posthoc aggregation** uses `--artifacts aggregator --checkpoint-choice best`.  
**func_* / lgbm_func_*** parameters are optimized via Nelder-Mead (maxiter=500, xatol=1e-4, fatol=1e-4) on the training set AUC.  
**lgbm_func_*** uses LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=200, num_leaves=31, lr=0.05, class_weight='balanced') to re-score walks before applying the weight function.

## 2. Baseline Models (Direct Edge Prediction)

These models predict per-edge directly — no walk aggregation needed.  
Metric: **direct test AUC** (not edge-aggregated).

| Model | Description | b-alpha | b-otc | epinion | wiki-e | wiki-r | slash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **CSG** | Cycle-based signed graph model | 0.8069 | 0.8143 | 0.7481 | 0.7131 | 0.6773 | 0.681 |
| **CSG-GSGNN** | CSG + graph signed GNN | 0.871 | 0.8758 | 0.9113 | 0.884 | 0.8673 | 0.8799 |
| **CopulaLSP** | Copula-based latent space model | 0.8666 | 0.8847 | 0.8898 | 0.8705 | 0.861 | 0.883 |
| **GSGNN+SGA** | Graph signed GNN + signed graph attention | 0.8804 | 0.9086 | 0.8665 | 0.8366 | — | 0.7262 |
| **SE-SGformer** | Signed edge transformer | 0.6072 | 0.7202 | — | 0.5731 | 0.5481 | — |
| **SNEA** | Signed network embedding with attention | 0.8718 | 0.8857 | 0.8925 | 0.8652 | 0.8568 | 0.8845 |

## 3. Walk-to-Paint Transformer Base

The transformer outputs **walk-level** probabilities q_j = P(trust | walk j).  
Edge-level score = simple mean of walk probabilities per edge (baseline aggregation).

| Metric | b-alpha | b-otc | epinion | wiki-e | wiki-r | slash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Val AUC | 0.9342 | 0.9247 | 0.9344 | 0.8544 | 0.8630 | 0.9279 |
| Walk Test AUC | 0.8613 | 0.9100 | 0.9322 | 0.8505 | 0.8419 | 0.8716 |

## 4. Posthoc: Basic Aggregation Models

These models aggregate walk-level predictions into edge-level scores.  
Metric: **edge-level test AUC**.

| Model | Description | b-alpha | b-otc | epinion | wiki-e | wiki-r | slash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `logistic` | Logistic regression on walk features (3 feats: q, rp, log_len) | 0.9038 | 0.9417 | 0.9320 | 0.8898 | 0.8819 | 0.8939 |
| `certainty` | φ_j = \\|q_j − 0.5\\|, weighted mean; no training | 0.9099 | 0.9426 | 0.9307 | 0.8928 | 0.8811 | 0.8951 |
| `lgbm` | LGBMClassifier on walk features (3 feats), soft-vote mean | 0.9129 | 0.9434 | 0.9446 | 0.8829 | 0.8820 | 0.8954 |
| `lgbm_max` | LGBM scores walk; max pooling per edge | 0.9068 | 0.9349 | 0.9258 | 0.8709 | 0.8721 | 0.8863 |
| `lgbm_lse` | LGBM scores walk; log-sum-exp pooling per edge | 0.9138 | 0.9434 | 0.9446 | 0.8825 | 0.8812 | 0.8954 |
| `lgbm_stats` | LGBM scores walks; edge-level stats (11 feats) → second LGBM | 0.9023 | 0.9324 | 0.9462 | 0.8835 | 0.8800 | 0.8971 |

## 5. Posthoc: Functional Weight Forms (func_*)

**What**: Each model defines a parametric weight function φ_j(θ) applied to transformer walk probabilities q_j.  
**Aggregation**: Edge score = Σ_j φ_j · q_j / Σ_j φ_j (weighted mean of q_j).  
**Training**: θ optimized on training edges via Nelder-Mead minimizing 1 − train AUC.  
**q_j**: transformer P(trust | walk j).

### 5.1 Length-based weights

| Model | Formula | Params | b-alpha | b-otc | epinion | wiki-e | wiki-r | slash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `func_uniform` | uniform mean | [] | 0.9088 | 0.9420 | 0.9305 | 0.8928 | 0.8814 | 0.8948 |
| `func_inv_len` | 1/len | [a] | 0.9079 | 0.9416 | 0.9301 | 0.8926 | 0.8813 | 0.8944 |
| `func_len_power` | len^{-a} | [a] | 0.9088 | 0.9425 | 0.9306 | 0.8925 | 0.8814 | 0.8949 |
| `func_len_exp` | exp(-a*len) | [a] | 0.9087 | 0.9424 | 0.9309 | 0.8928 | 0.8811 | 0.8949 |
| `func_len_harmonic` | harmonic len weight | [a] | 0.9087 | 0.9420 | 0.9307 | 0.8928 | 0.8814 | 0.8949 |

## 6. Posthoc: LGBM-Scored Functional Forms (lgbm_func_*)

**Same weight functions as Section 5**, but q_j is replaced by **LGBM-rescored** probabilities:  
1. Train LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=200, leaves=31, lr=0.05, class_weight='balanced') on walk features  
2. q_j^lgbm = LGBM.predict_proba(walk)[:,1]  
3. Apply same φ_j(θ) weight formula with q_j^lgbm  
4. θ optimized via Nelder-Mead on training edge AUC

## 7. Posthoc: Attention Models

These models use learned attention over walks. Require GPU.  

| Model | Description | b-alpha | b-otc | epinion | wiki-e | wiki-r | slash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `attention` | Dot-product attention over walk embeddings | 0.9016 | 0.9414 | 0.9303 | 0.8896 | 0.8781 | 0.8917 |
| `self_attention` | Multi-head self-attention on walk set | 0.8794 | 0.9418 | 0.9453 | 0.8937 | 0.8834 | 0.8958 |
| `set_attention` | Set transformer (SAB) over walks | 0.8614 | 0.9421 | 0.9449 | 0.8852 | 0.8781 | 0.8946 |
| `lgbm_attention` | LGBM re-scores walks → dot-product attention | 0.9132 | 0.9414 | 0.9446 | 0.8792 | 0.8800 | 0.8918 |
| `lgbm_self_attention` | LGBM re-scores walks → self-attention | 0.9114 | 0.9385 | 0.9457 | 0.8865 | 0.8829 | 0.8957 |
| `lgbm_set_attention` | LGBM re-scores walks → set transformer | 0.9112 | 0.9367 | 0.9455 | 0.8849 | 0.8791 | 0.8956 |

## 8. Best Results Summary

Best **edge-level test AUC** per dataset across all posthoc models.

### 8.1 Overall best per dataset

| Dataset | Best model | Test AUC | vs best baseline |
|---|---|---|---|
| bitcoin-alpha | `lgbm_func_invq_exp` | 0.9140 | +0.0336 vs GSGNN+SGA (0.8804) |
| bitcoin-otc | `lgbm_func_conf_logit` | 0.9436 | +0.0350 vs GSGNN+SGA (0.9086) |
| epinions | `lgbm_stats` | 0.9462 | +0.0349 vs CSG-GSGNN (0.9113) |
| wiki-elec | `self_attention` | 0.8937 | +0.0097 vs CSG-GSGNN (0.884) |
